mapper.sql: SELECT 'board' AS doc_type, bp.id AS doc_id, bp.title AS title, ts_headline('simple', COALESCE(bp.content_text, bp.title), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=30,MinWords=5,MaxFragments=2') AS snippet, ts_headline('simple', bp.title, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=15,MinWords=3,MaxFragments=1,HighlightAll=true') AS highlight, (ts_rank_cd(bp.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query})) * #{weights.board}) AS rank, bp.created_at AS created_at, ('/board/posts/' || bp.id) AS url, 'board' AS domain FROM bbs_post bp JOIN bbs_master bm ON bm.id = bp.bbs_id WHERE bp.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(bm.type, '') <> 'PUBLICATION' AND (#{isAdmin} = true OR bp.is_secret = false OR bp.author_id = #{requesterId})

SELECT 'publication' AS doc_type, bp.id AS doc_id, bp.title AS title, ts_headline('simple', COALESCE(bp.content_text, bp.title), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=30,MinWords=5,MaxFragments=2') AS snippet, ts_headline('simple', bp.title, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=15,MinWords=3,MaxFragments=1,HighlightAll=true') AS highlight, (ts_rank_cd(bp.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query})) * #{weights.publication}) AS rank, bp.created_at AS created_at, ('/board/publications/' || bp.id) AS url, 'publication' AS domain FROM bbs_post bp JOIN bbs_master bm ON bm.id = bp.bbs_id WHERE bp.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL AND bm.type = 'PUBLICATION'

SELECT 'content' AS doc_type, p.id AS doc_id, p.title AS title, SUBSTRING(p.title FROM 1 FOR 200) AS snippet, NULL AS highlight, (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' THEN 0.9 ELSE 0.5 END * #{weights.content}) AS rank, p.created_at AS created_at, ('/content/pages/' || p.id || '/edit') AS url, 'content' AS domain FROM page p WHERE p.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT 'policy' AS doc_type, pp.id AS doc_id, pp.program_name AS title, CASE WHEN pp.description_html IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(pp.description_html) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(pp.description_html FROM 1 FOR 200) ELSE pp.program_name END AS snippet, NULL AS highlight, ( CASE WHEN pp.program_name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' THEN 0.8 WHEN pp.description_html ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.3 END * #{weights.policy} ) AS rank, pp.created_at AS created_at, ('/policy/programs/' || pp.id) AS url, 'policy' AS domain FROM policy_program pp WHERE (pp.program_name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR pp.description_html ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT 'safety' AS doc_type, si.id AS doc_id, si.summary AS title, ts_headline('simple', si.summary, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=30,MinWords=5,MaxFragments=2') AS snippet, ts_headline('simple', si.summary, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}), 'StartSel=<mark>,StopSel=</mark>,MaxWords=15,MinWords=3,MaxFragments=1,HighlightAll=true') AS highlight, (ts_rank_cd(si.search_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query})) * #{weights.safety}) AS rank, si.created_at AS created_at, ('/safety/incidents/' || si.id) AS url, 'safety' AS domain FROM safety_incident si WHERE si.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND si.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT 'media' AS doc_type, ma.id AS doc_id, ma.original_filename AS title, COALESCE(SUBSTRING(ma.description FROM 1 FOR 200), ma.original_filename) AS snippet, NULL AS highlight, (0.5 * #{weights.media}) AS rank, ma.created_at AS created_at, ('/media/' || ma.id) AS url, 'media' AS domain FROM media_asset ma WHERE (ma.original_filename ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR ma.description ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.status = 'READY'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT 1 FROM bbs_post bp JOIN bbs_master bm ON bm.id = bp.bbs_id WHERE bp.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(bm.type, '') <> 'PUBLICATION' AND (#{isAdmin} = true OR bp.is_secret = false OR bp.author_id = #{requesterId})
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM bbs_post bp JOIN bbs_master bm ON bm.id = bp.bbs_id WHERE bp.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL AND bm.type = 'PUBLICATION'
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM page p WHERE p.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM policy_program pp WHERE (pp.program_name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR pp.description_html ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM safety_incident si WHERE si.search_vector @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) AND si.status = 'PUBLISHED'
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM media_asset ma WHERE (ma.original_filename ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR ma.description ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.status = 'READY'
) c

SELECT term, similarity FROM ( SELECT bp.title AS term, similarity(bp.title, #{prefix}) AS similarity FROM bbs_post bp WHERE bp.title % #{prefix} AND bp.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.title AS term, similarity(p.title, #{prefix}) AS similarity FROM page p WHERE p.title % #{prefix} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' UNION ALL SELECT pp.program_name AS term, similarity(pp.program_name, #{prefix}) AS similarity FROM policy_program pp WHERE pp.program_name % #{prefix} AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' ) auto WHERE similarity >= 0.3 ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT normalized_query AS "query", COUNT(*) AS "searchCount", COUNT(clicked_doc_id) AS "clickCount", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COUNT(clicked_doc_id)::float / COUNT(*)::float END AS "ctr" FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY normalized_query ORDER BY "searchCount" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT normalized_query) FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN result_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*)::float END FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(response_ms), 0.0) FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= #{from}::date AND created_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
